column3: “after a while” renders “from days”; “her room” renders “the chamber.”
“really” and “intensely” render the doubled verbs; “more beautiful” renders “better.”
“blameless in regard to” renders “free from.”
NASB supplies “the foxes.”
“released the foxes” renders “sent them”; “the vineyards and groves” renders “the vineyard of olive trees.”
“they said” renders an impersonal reply; “came up” renders “went up.”
“Since” renders “If”; “I will surely take revenge” renders “except I have avenged myself.”
“ruthlessly” renders the idiom “leg upon thigh.”
Close to the Hebrew.
“the men of Judah” renders the collective “the man of Judah.”
Close to the Hebrew.
“kill me” renders “fall upon me”; “hands” renders the Hebrew singular “hand.”
“bind you fast” renders the doubled verb; “surely we will not kill you” renders the doubled verb.
“came upon him mightily” renders “rushed upon him.”
“reached out” renders “stretched out his hand.”
“Heaps upon heaps” renders “a heap, two heaps,” a wordplay on the Hebrew for “donkey.”
“Ramath-lehi” means “hill of the jawbone.”
“deliverance” renders “victory”; “hands” renders the Hebrew singular “hand.”
“his strength returned” renders “his spirit returned.” “En-hakkore” means “spring of the one who called.”
Close to the Hebrew.
